Brain Audit Marketing Advisor 1.0.0 – First release

- Provides natural, conversational marketing and sales advice using the Brain Audit framework in Thai.
- Actively listens and tailors guidance based on the user's real situation, never relying on rigid checklists or technical jargon.
- Assists with tasks such as writing sales pages, crafting offers, creating presentation outlines, and improving closing techniques.
- Instantly delivers simple visual summaries (flowcharts, before-after, diagrams) when the information is clear enough.
- Only applies this skill to real marketing or sales concerns—excludes theory-only, SEO, data analytics, or design questions.
